text: maya (Product Designer): flagged during hallway testing: the alert SLO editor preview shows a suppression pill inline with channel chips. People keep assuming it's a filter for channels. thoughts on making it clearer? screenshot: https://redwood-internal.screenshots/ghi789.png frank (Frontend): quick options: 1) visually separate with a thin rule + 8px gap, 2) move to actions toolbar, 3) add microcopy below it. rule is lowest-risk. jules (Accessibility): whichever we pick, ensure the control uses role="switch" and has an `aria-checked` state. also keyboard focus must be visible in dark mode (current contrast fails). For SRs, prefer updating a visually-hidden status text instead of aria-live for toggles. maya (Product Designer): i prefer rule + gap. Ben, can you confirm design tokens for focus color in dark mode? ben (Design Ops): we have --focus-color-dark and --focus-outline-width tokens. recommend `--focus-color-dark: #e6f3ff` for 3:1 on our surfaces. I'll add a compact variant token too. frank (Frontend): implementing pseudo-element for divider and `outline-offset` to avoid layout shift. prototype CSS: ```.row__suppress::before { content: ''; position: absolute; left: -8px; width:1px; background: var(--divider); height: 16px; transform: translateY(6px);} .suppress:focus-visible{ outline: var(--focus-outline-width) solid var(--focus-color-dark); outline-offset: 2px; }``` jules (Accessibility): looks fine. also ensure the switch announces "Suppression on/off" and not just "button". Use ``. maya (Product Designer): one more: when suppression is active, the preview hides channels which test participants found disorienting. Let's keep channels visible but dim and append an inline chip "Muted" so people know which channels remain suppressed. frank (Frontend): will keep badges and add `.badge--muted` class with `opacity: .35;` plus an extra `Muted`. We'll also set `aria-hidden=true` on decorative icons inside badges. deploy-bot: created branch `feat/suppress-divider` from main by frank at 2025-07-22 11:02:12 UTC frank (Frontend): i pushed a working demo to the branch. link: https://staging.redwood/feat/suppress-divider jules (Accessibility): quick checklist from me once staging is up: - role=switch and aria-checked toggles correctly - sr-only state text updates - focus-visible color token applied in dark and light themes - NVDA/VoiceOver smoke test - no layout shift on toggle - aria-hidden on decorative divider - translations for muted chip label eni (QA): i'll run a quick user flow test on staging after you merge. aim to ship in next patch release. maya (Product Designer): perfect, thanks. i'll update the figma and add annotations for the token names. :thumbsup:
